title: Teenieping Characters List: Names, Powers and Every Royal Teenieping by Season (2026)
summary: Every Catch! Teenieping character by season: Romi, Heartsping, all Royal Teeniepings, Legends and villains, plus the new Season 7 team and their powers.
body_markdown:
**Quick answer:** The main characters of **[Catch! Teenieping](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catch!_Teenieping)** are **Romi** , the princess of the Emotion Kingdom, and **Heartsping** , her personal Teenieping of love. Every season gives Heartsping a new team of **Royal Teeniepings** and sends a new themed group of Teeniepings to Earth for Romi to catch: Emotion, Jewel, Key, Dessert, Star, Princess and now Stage Teeniepings. Season 7, *Jewel Catch! Teenieping* , adds **Lemonping** , **Cherryping** and **Limeping** to the team.


Below is every Royal Teenieping by season, the villains and Legend Teeniepings, a list of fan-favorite Teeniepings with their powers, and the main human cast. Names follow the official English names used by SAMG Entertainment and the fan wiki. Some fan translations and older dubs spell a few of them differently.


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


Teenieping Characters at a Glance (All 7 Seasons)


#


Season Teenieping group Royal Teeniepings (with Heartsping) Legend / villain Teeniepings


1 · *Catch! Teenieping* (2020–21) Emotion Teeniepings Dadaping, Gogoping, Chachaping, Lalaping, Happying Giggleping, Egoping (villains)


2 · *Twinkle Catch! Teenieping* (2021–22) Jewel Teeniepings Joahping, Teeheeping, Trustping Maskping / Onlyping (villain)


3 · *Secret Catch! Teenieping* (2022–23) Key Teeniepings Okeydokeyping, Nanaping, Trueping Luckyping (Legend)


4 · *Dessert Catch! Teenieping* (2023–24) Dessert Teeniepings Shashaping, Fluffyping, Jellyping Sweetping, Tangyping (Legend); Puffping (villain)


5 · *Star Catch! Teenieping* (2024–25) Star Teeniepings Shimmerping, Sparkleping, Twinkleping, Princeping Auroraping (Legend)


6 · *Princess Catch! Teenieping* (2025–26) Princess Teeniepings Graceping, Claireping, Bonnyping Dianaping, Eclipseping (Legend)


7 · *Jewel Catch! Teenieping* (2026) Stage Teeniepings Lemonping, Cherryping, Limeping Museping, Divaping (Legend)


Across the seven seasons and two movies, the fan-run[Catch! Teenieping Wiki list](https://catchteenieping.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Teeniepings) names well over 150 different Teeniepings, so this guide focuses on the ones fans search for most: the Royal teams, the Legends, the villains and the memorable regulars.


##


Who Is the Main Teenieping? Romi and Heartsping


#


**Romi** is the main protagonist. She is the crown princess of the Emotion Kingdom who lives in Harmony Town on Earth and secretly transforms into a magical princess whenever a loose Teenieping causes trouble. She has to keep that identity hidden, because the people of Harmony Town don’t believe in magic.


**Heartsping** is the Royal Teenieping of love and Romi’s personal Teenieping. She is the only Teenieping who leads the team in every season, and each season gives her a new look and name variant: **Dia Heartsping** (Season 2), **Flora Heartsping** (Season 3), **Berry Heartsping** (Season 4), **Star Heartsping** (Season 5) and **Princess Heartsping** (Season 6). Her Korean name is Hachuping (하츄핑).


© SAMG


##


Royal Teeniepings by Season: Which Teenieping Is Which


#


###


Season 1: Royal Emotion Teeniepings


#


- **Heartsping** : love. Heart-themed and the team leader.
- **Dadaping** : rightness. Cloud-themed, studious and full of inventive ideas.
- **Gogoping** : courage. Star-themed, sporty and impulsive.
- **Chachaping** : hope. Nature-themed and calm, she never gives up hope.
- **Lalaping** : joy. Music-themed, she sings loudly to lift the team’s mood.
- **Happying** : happiness. Sunshine-themed and the last Royal Teenieping Romi finds, because she had secretly been turned into the prankster **Giggleping** .


Season 1’s final villain is **Egoping** , the Teenieping of selfishness, who tricked Happying and controlled Giggleping.


###


Season 2: Royal Jewel Teeniepings


#


- **Joahping** : kindness. Wields the Emerald.
- **Teeheeping** : laughter. Wields the Ruby and has a tomboy streak.
- **Trustping** : trust. Wields the Sapphire. The youngest and most naive of the trio.


Heartsping wields the Pink Diamond this season. The masked villain **Maskping** releases the Jewel Teeniepings and is later revealed to be **Onlyping** , the Teenieping of dedication and personal Teenieping of Romi’s cousin Jennie.


###


Season 3: Royal Key Teeniepings


#


- **Okeydokeyping** : peace. Winter-themed, gentle and sociable.
- **Nanaping** : passion. Sunshine-themed, confident but short on patience.
- **Trueping** : honesty. Star- and cloud-themed, and sometimes too honest.


The mysterious Teenieping locked in a box turns out to be **Luckyping** , the Legend Teenieping of luck. Jennie is the main antagonist of this season before she gets a second chance.


###


Season 4: Royal Dessert Teeniepings


#


- **Shashaping** : optimism. Ice cream-themed.
- **Fluffyping** : innocence. Cotton candy-themed, kind to everyone.
- **Jellyping** : fun. Jelly-themed, lively and quirky.


The Legend Teeniepings are **Sweetping** (sweetness) and **Tangyping** (refreshment). The bubblegum-themed villain **Puffping** steals the Magic Sugar Ball, which scatters the Dessert Teeniepings across Earth.


###


Season 5: Royal Star Teeniepings


#


- **Shimmerping** : healing. Gentle and emotional.
- **Sparkleping** : wishes. Confident, lively and a bit of a show-off.
- **Twinkleping** : bright and quirky, with unpredictable energy.
- **Princeping** : longing. The personal Teenieping of Noah, a prince from the North Pole Planet.


The Legend Teenieping of this season is **Auroraping** , the Teenieping of promise. The Star Teeniepings are constellation-themed. For example, Mightyping is themed on Ursa Major and Swayping on Orion.


###


Season 6: Royal Princess Teeniepings


#


- **Graceping** : grace. Elegant and warm-hearted.
- **Claireping** : beauty. Pure, bright and kind.
- **Bonnyping** : confidence. Cheerful, outgoing and a natural leader.


Two Legend Princess Teeniepings shape this season: **Dianaping** , the Teenieping of glory, and **Eclipseping** , the Teenieping of seclusion and the season’s main antagonist. Season 6 also brings back Happying and Fluffyping and introduces Prince Teeniepings like Charlesping and Henryping.


###


Season 7: Royal Stage Teeniepings (New)


#


*Jewel Catch! Teenieping* is the seventh season, with 20 episodes, and it premieres in Korea in November 2026. The Emotion Kingdom is preparing its Emotion Festival when the Legend Teeniepings who were set to headline it disappear. Romi teams up with a new Royal team to find them:


- **Lemonping** : spotlight. Confident, outgoing and cool.
- **Cherryping** : diligence. Stylish, meticulous and always planning ahead.
- **Limeping** : beat. Cute and quirky, with hip-hop charm on stage.


© SAMG


The Legend Stage Teeniepings are **Museping** and **Divaping** . Regular Stage Teeniepings such as Cutieping, Romeoping and Julietping have been named, but their powers hadn’t been described yet when this guide was written.


##


Fan-Favorite Teeniepings and Their Powers


#


Every regular Teenieping stands for an emotion or idea, and its power usually spreads that feeling to the people around it. That is how each episode’s chaos starts.


Teenieping Season Represents Power


Kikiping 1 Playfulness Makes others play pranks


Charmping 1 Cuteness Makes others act cute


Shyping 1 Shyness Makes others shy


Dreamping 1 Imagination Creates illusions and turns into objects


Weeping 1 Sadness Turns tears into “tear candies”


Spookping 1 Fear Shows others their greatest fears


Tickleping 2 Mischief (Citrine) Summons feathers to tickle others


Wishping 2 Desire (Spinel) Grants wishes


Cozyping 2 Coziness (Moonstone) Creates knitted items


Wizping 3 Inquiry A purple potion pool that makes others slip and switch bodies


Fashionping 3 Originality Changes others’ clothes into new designs


Splashping 3 Freedom Grows a mermaid tail and talks to sea animals


Macaping 4 Color (macaron) Changes the color of anyone or anything


Lolliping 4 Rotation (lollipop) Makes objects spin


Lucyping 5 Transparency Turns people, objects and herself invisible


Swayping 5 Excitement Makes anything dance


Flitterping 6 Lightness Gives things wings so they can fly


Silkyping 6 Adventure Moves objects with silk strings


##


Human Characters in Catch! Teenieping


#


- **Romi** : princess of the Emotion Kingdom and the series lead.
- **Maya** and **Marylou** : Romi’s best friends. Maya is sweet and a little shy, and Marylou is sporty and competitive.
- **Sarah** : Romi’s older cousin, who runs the Heartrose Bakery.
- **Ian** , **Kyle** and **Jun** : the young bakers at Heartrose Bakery, each dreaming of becoming a pastry chef or owning a bakery.
- **Jennie** (also spelled Jenny): Romi’s cousin, introduced in Season 2, who turns out to have released the Teeniepings.
- **Dr. Monziu** : the Emotion Kingdom scientist who invents Romi’s catching tools.
- **Noah** : a prince of the North Pole Planet, introduced in Season 5.


##


Teenieping Movies and Their Characters


#


- ***Heartsping: Teenieping of Love*** (released in Korea on August 7, 2024) tells how Romi first met Heartsping.
- ***Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone*** (released in Korea on August 5, 2026) takes Romi and Heartsping under the sea with a boy named Kite and the Sea Teeniepings **Shellyping** , **Wavyping** and **Bubbleping** .


© SAMG


Want to watch along? Netflix’s[Catch! Teenieping page](https://www.netflix.com/title/81507677) lists four seasons, from *Catch! Teenieping* to *Dessert Catch! Teenieping* . Catalogs vary by country, so check what is available where you live.


##


How Teenieping Names Work


#


Almost every Teenieping name is **a theme word + “-ping”** : Shyping is shy, Macaping is a macaron, and Lemonping is a lemon. The English names are localized, so they often don’t match the Korean originals. Joahping comes from the Korean 좋아 (“good”), while Okeydokeyping’s English name comes from “okey dokey”. ##


FAQ


#


###


Who is the main character in Catch! Teenieping?


#


Romi, the crown princess of the Emotion Kingdom, is the main character. Her partner Heartsping, the Royal Teenieping of love, is the main Teenieping and appears in every season.


###


How many Teeniepings are there?


#


There are well over 150 named Teeniepings across the seven seasons and two movies, according to the fan wiki’s full list. Each season adds a new group: Emotion, Jewel, Key, Dessert, Star, Princess and Stage Teeniepings.


###


Who are the new Royal Teeniepings in Season 7?


#


Jewel Catch! Teenieping (Season 7) introduces Lemonping (spotlight), Cherryping (diligence) and Limeping (beat), who join Heartsping. The Legend Stage Teeniepings are Museping and Divaping.


###


Who is the villain in Catch! Teenieping?


#


It changes every season. Egoping and Giggleping in Season 1, Maskping (Onlyping) and Jennie in Seasons 2 and 3, Puffping in Season 4 and Eclipseping in Season 6 are the best-known villains.


###


What is Heartsping’s Korean name?


#


Heartsping is called Hachuping (하츄핑) in Korean. Most Teeniepings have different Korean and English names because the English names are localized.
